headline: Names a post office building in Fountain Hills, Arizona, after Dr. C.T. Wright.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 16605 East Avenue of the Fountains in Fountain Hills, Arizona, as the Dr. C.T. Wright Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates, what services it provides, or what customers pay.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the designation applies from that date.
